title: Summarize numbers
description: Count, total, mean and range of a JSON array of finite numbers. Empty input returns null mean and bounds. Rejects non-numeric values.
source: values => { if (!Array.isArray(values) || values.some(x => typeof x !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(x))) throw new Error('Expected finite numbers'); let sum=0,min=null,max=null; for(const x of values){sum+=x;min=min===null?x:Math.min(min,x);max=max===null?x:Math.max(max,x);} if(!Number.isFinite(sum))throw new Error('Overflow'); return {count:values.length,sum,mean:values.length?sum/values.length:null,min,max}; }
